thread: Jaina's promised night re-check of the horses

evidence.clue: Ch2 afternoon: Jaina says she wants to check the horses again 'tonight'; Sylvanas says 'You will.'

Ch3 night in the inn yard: Jaina: 'I said I'd look at them tonight.' Sylvanas had forgotten: 'Then look.' The mage listens with the staff heel set between each horse's forefeet and her cheek on the wood; the grey longest; Sylvanas's mare last. 'Clean. All of them. Tired horses, nothing else.' Not understood: 'They've walked through it all day and drunk out of the stream at the culvert, and it isn't in them.'

povCharacterKnows: Sylvanas: horses clean; the mage does not understand why.
notes: Resolved as a promise. The underlying puzzle (why horses stay clean) is part of contamination-in-living-animals.
